fix(codeon): stabilize autonomous execution recovery (#112)

* fix(codeon): harden provider execution

Make recovery and completion handling durable across daemon restarts.

Persist repository verification evidence, tighten revision and landing gates, and complete Cursor/Grok transport, timeout, commit, and cleanup paths.

Includes database migrations 0101 through 0104.

* fix(codeon): harden agent request validation

Reject invalid provider requests at the operation boundary so one bad model configuration cannot terminate the daemon. Require Review finding authority before completion and allow rejected dispatches to use the audited MCP cancellation path.

* fix(codeon): stabilize session inspection

* fix(cursor): classify prompt transport closure

* fix(codeon): finalize approved no-change work

* fix(codeon): isolate missing preflight authority

* fix(codeon): make preparation recovery operable

Allow operators to cancel attempts that fail before operation creation. The cancellation seals runtime closure, abandons the never-dispatched attempt, and atomically requeues the original Issue.

Migration 0105 extends the attention reason and action constraints.

* fix(codeon): requeue runtime recovery cancel

Explicit operator cancellation fences late callbacks and requeues the original Issue while preserving published PR evidence. Idempotent replay repairs orphaned In Progress issues left by earlier behavior.

Queue best-effort cleanup only after Issue finalization so retry attempts can continue reusing their published PR.

A changed operation recovery authority must supersede its stale active attention before an operator-cancel attention can be opened.

Migration 0108 permits only the exact durable ImplementationArtifactInvalid replay to restore the recovered attempt.

* fix(codeon): recover rejected preflight

Retry legacy AgentPreflightRejected operations only after the currently configured runner reports compatible preflight evidence. The migration permits only the exact failed-to-recovery event shape required for this repair.

* fix(codeon): retry legacy Grok timeout

A closed Grok prompt-timeout runtime has no remaining external execution to reconcile. Re-run only that exact legacy failure after the current provider preflight succeeds; explicit agent failures and invalid artifacts remain operator-gated.

* fix(codeon): replace failed retry dispatch

A terminal failed dispatch without completion evidence is already closed and cannot be cancelled again. Revoke its callback capability and create the next deterministic dispatch while preserving fail-closed behavior for completed or non-cancellable states.

* fix(codeon): validate review authority

Reject findings without structured authority at provider tool ingress. Replay pre-validation completions with durable dispatch lineage.

* fix(codeon): finalize recovered reviews

Replay validated legacy Review completions through the exact failed-operation database guard and restore the Attempt atomically.

* fix(codeon): replace failed review dispatch

* fix(codeon): deliver recovered review handoff

Recovered Review finalization restores the Attempt to canonical version 4. Accept the exact previously persisted version-5 handoff only when append-only recovery evidence proves its lineage.

* fix(codeon): recover transient verification

Retry ordinary verification command failures once, rerun failed GitHub Actions checks with a durable attempt boundary, and allow authoritative no-change check recovery. Preserve legacy callback catalog restart identity.
